verdict.rationale: Publishing independent security audits is a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions third-party audits, penetration test reports, or reviews of the app or its sync protocol. The items cover the CLI, SDKs, SSH, passkeys, Watchtower and import/export, none of which address independent audits.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the vendor publishes independent security audits of the app and its sync protocol
